messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGER: GeoDNS probes failing in ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo). Severity: P1. Query fail rate across external probes > 40% for domain redwood.example.com. Paging: @mike oncall-sre. Incident id INC-2026-123

mike: ack, looking. grabbing logs and probe outputs. will triage impact and decide failover.

anya: seeing spike in 502/504 from services behind that domain, only from APAC clients. quick dig from my laptop shows inconsistent answers: some CF resolvers returning SERVFAIL, others OK.

cloudops_amelia: confirming from our vantage: route53 healthchecks are green, origin is healthy. external resolver matrix shows Cloudflare edges (ap-northeast-1) returning SERVFAIL intermittently. running multi-probe dig now (results below).

cloudops_amelia: ```
# dig +short @1.1.1.1 redwood.example.com A
52.12.34.56
# dig +short @203.119.0.1 redwood.example.com A
; (server failed)
# dig +short @216.239.32.10 redwood.example.com A
52.12.34.56
# dig +short @198.41.0.4 redwood.example.com A
; connection timed out
```

support_jordan: influx of customer tickets in APAC about search timeouts and API 504s. ETA on mitigation? customers: ~120 accounts with recent errors, top-affected: acme-inc, quicksend.

mike: taking ownership. plan: 1) fail traffic for APAC to secondary geo pool (lower weight on CF-backed pool), 2) lower TTL for affected record to 30s to accelerate propagation, 3) notify customers + watch. Executing now: `geodnsctl set-weight redwood.example.com apac-primary 0 apac-secondary 100`

deploy-bot: runbook step started: "geodns failover" (ID task-6621).

anya: +1 on TTL change. From console: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --change-batch file://lower-ttl.json` (payload uses TTL 30). Note: watch for resolver caching — CF may still hold old answers for a bit.

cloudops_amelia: applied failover weights and pushed TTL change. Confirming with probes — showing improvement from some vantage points. Probe summary (success % by region): TOKYO 82% -> 98% after failover, SYD 76% -> 95%, SFO unchanged.

mike: posting exact commands used: ```
# set apac weights to secondary
geodnsctl patch redwood.example.com --zone ap-northeast-1 --set weight=0 --auth @sec
geodnsctl patch redwood.example.com --zone ap-northeast-1-secondary --set weight=100 --auth @sec
# route53 TTL change
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z12345678 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"redwood.example.com.","Type":"A","TTL":30,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"52.12.34.56"}]}}]}'
```

support_jordan: customers paged with status msg. template used: "We're aware of intermittent DNS failures affecting APAC customers. We've applied a geo failover and reduced TTL to accelerate recovery. We're monitoring. Ref INC-2026-123."

alia: I sent the customer-facing note to impacted accounts and posted the status page update. Tracking replies.

anya: Cloudflare support case opened: CF-78910. They acknowledged internal edge degradation in ap-northeast region and will patch. Link: https://support.cloudflare.com/cases/CF-78910 (internal).

cloudops_amelia: additional probe output after change: ```
# tokyo probe @203.119.0.1
52.12.34.56
# tokyo probe @203.119.0.2
52.12.34.56
# sydney probe @13.32.0.1
52.12.34.56
```

mike: traffic and application metrics are trending back to normal for APAC. Error budget impact estimated: ~3% of global requests over last 45m. Current status: mitigated but monitoring for 2 hours. Assigning follow-up to eng-net + cloudops for RCA and postmortem.

support_jordan: opening support ticket aggregation doc for impacted customers (link internal).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-123 status update: MITIGATED -> MONITORING. Owner: mike. Actions: follow-up RCA, update runbook with CF edge fallback steps.

mike: adding action items: - eng-net investigate Cloudflare edge cause & liaise with CF - cloudops confirm geoDNS automation thresholds - devex update incident runbook (short TTL procedure) - notify sales for top impacted accounts. I'll draft postmortem after logs and CF ticket updates.

anya: quick note: avoid re-raising primary weights until CF confirms edge stable for >30m. We'll monitor probe matrix and WAF logs for anomalies.

mike: thanks team. I'll keep thread open while monitoring. If anything regresses, escalate immediately. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: runbook step completed: "geodns failover" (task-6621) status: success.

incident-bot: Last update at 2799990280. If no regressions, incident will be closed after 2h of stable metrics.
